EMA Crossover.details: Generates buy and sell signals based on the crossover of a short-term and long-term exponential moving average

inputs.name: short_window
inputs.description: Number of periods for the short-term EMA (Recommended: 5–20)

inputs.name: long_window
inputs.description: Number of periods for the long-term EMA (Recommended: 20–50)

RSI.details: Generates buy and sell signals using RSI overbought and oversold levels

inputs.name: window
inputs.description: Number of periods used to calculate RSI

inputs.name: overbought
inputs.description: RSI level above which the asset is considered overbought

inputs.name: oversold
inputs.description: RSI level below which the asset is considered oversold
